name: Micro Standard v2
source: Cloud Code Design Wave 2 + approved Micro Component Expansion v1
updated_by: Manus audit reconciliation of run-20260913-msv2-zai-01 — contrast and handoff integrity fixes; no new palette color

create_add_fab.rule: Terracotta is the identity surface. Text-bearing create/add uses dark ink for readable text; icon-only FAB/icon buttons use white icons. Never use the role for financial values, chart fills, statuses, or general commitment.

ordinary_save_confirm.rule: Warm Tint surface with dark ink and icon; pressed shows a #C96442 edge; pressing never converts the action into a success state; completion is a word plus semantic marker, not color alone.

high_consequence_commit.rule: Warm-ink filled surface reserved for high-consequence commitment and justified destructive confirmation: consequence word, icon, short explanation, and an independent confirmation path.

destructive.rule: Error role with words and an icon; destructive confirmation uses the high-consequence contract.

semantic_state_presentation.rule: Every financial state uses words plus a non-color marker (icon, shape, or sign); color never carries the state alone.

states.unknown: word + marker on neutral ink; never rendered as success or failure

semantic_state_presentation.tint_grammar: Tinted state marks reuse the #F5F4ED ground with the semantic ink; no new tint hex values exist in this package.

functional_derivatives.disclosure: Alpha composites of approved base values used for scrim and translucent header only; they are not new palette members.
functional_derivatives.shadow_ink: rgba(60, 50, 40, x) elevation shadow tone from the recorded evidence values

type_scale.numeric_hierarchy: hero 28 / primary 24 / secondary 15 / tertiary 13 tabular mono; financial facts never below 15px

geometry.radius: 12 controls · 16 cards · 18 segment · 20 sheet · full pills

motion.reduced_motion: nonessential movement removed; state and action meaning preserved

state_rule: Every financial state uses words plus a non-color marker.
product_boundary: Visual contracts only; no financial policy or synchronization behavior.
